Description.SourceString:
After all that has happened, after all the trials that you have passed, it is perhaps a little anticlimactic to be holding onto a single head of Kuldra. You could have severed them all, of course, which would have been a far more impressive wall-hanging, but then there's the transportation, and the question of how much salt or pickle that you would need to preserve a head full of poison, another full of fire, and so on. And would it have underlined your achievement any more than what you are holding now?

The real trophy is Ashenfall. Without your actions, it would have burnt and curled in Kuldra's fire; a lifeless husk where beauty once was. Thanks to you, it can grow into whatever shape that Fate has planned for it. There's no better trophy than that.
